traits.leaf_incision.note: Wikipedia Heuchera (read 2026-10-17): about 37 to 45 species; long-stalked basal leaves, palmately lobed.

traits.inflorescence.note: Wikipedia Heuchera (read 2026-10-17): flowers borne in long thyrses in spring; a thyrse (branched axis of small cymes) is drawn here as a panicle.
